build: Apache Doris 4.1.5 (Docker apache/doris:fe-4.1.5, apache/doris:be-4.1.5), Iceberg Java 1.11.0, doris-4.1.5-release-917b20be838, pymysql 1.2.3

views.note: Doris 4.1.5 raises "Cannot get engine-name for view" because the view versions record no engine-name, which the Iceberg view spec makes optional; apache/doris#69829 (merged to master on 2026-11-02) loads such views.

incremental-read.note: Doris documents @incr incremental reads for Hudi and Paimon tables, not for Iceberg tables (doris.apache.org/docs/lakehouse/catalogs/iceberg-catalog); on an Iceberg table Doris accepts @incr and ignores it, returning all 8 rows of the table.

timestamps.note: The MySQL protocol carries TIMESTAMPTZ(6) as text in the session time zone, so the instant is read as epoch milliseconds through MILLISECOND_TIMESTAMP.
